main_text.p: 2. ut dicant eius adoratores: Quis similis beftiæ aut quis poterit pugnare cum eâ? Apoc.13. Sed nec diu superstes mansit hic Hadrianus post depressam authoritatem Cæsaream. Anno enim Domini 886. ex hac vita repente migravit, cum magnam de ipsa sobolem concepissent papicolæ.
main_text.head: 47. STEPHANVS quintus.
main_text.p: STephanus quintus, patria quoque Romanus, eo tempore papatum iniit, quo Gallia Normannis, Anglia Dacis, Pannonia Hunnis, & Italia Saracenis collustabantur. Vixit multa perturbatione & animi tædio, toto Papatus sui tempore (pœ-na certe tantæ temeritati debita) quoniam Itali inquieta fuit, & Romani non satis parebant. Fecit tamen quod potuit, ut sua synagoga, scortum impudens, in malis de die in diem proficeret, & ut eius iuribus nihil detraheretur. Nam ut Gratia-nus scribit, dist. 19. Erimuero[?]. Statuta Romana Ecclesiæ omnibus necessario obseruanda, primum esse decreuit. Idem pontifex (inquit) iudicium can-dentis ferri & feruentis aquæ (quod tum in usu e-rat) Christianis inhibuit. cau.2.q.4. Permisit hic D. Martini corpus in Gallia, tempore incursionis Normannorum, à Turonis Altissiodorum depor-tari, litigantibus utrinq; propter oblationes mo-nachis. Celebratur etiam ab Antonino papistico

page.notes: Catchword "feria" is printed alone at the lower right; the last line of the page ends at "papistico". The word "feria" at the foot is partly cut off by the edge of the scan, so the catchword reading "feria" is uncertain. "Erimuero" is hard to read at the line start; the reading is doubtful. Faint marks at the lower left (around "ii") and at the foot of the page are too unclear to read; they may be a signature or show-through and are left out. The "S" of "STephanus" is an enlarged initial joined to the following word. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout; the printed text uses long s, which looks like f in the scan. Printing errors are kept as they stand, e.g. "dist." for the citation.
